title: Revealing H<SUB>2</SUB>D<SUP>+</SUP> Depletion and Compact Structure in Starless and Protostellar Cores with ALMA
question: What small-scale structure and H2D+ distribution exist in the Oph A SM1 and SM1N cores, and are they starless or protostellar?

data.arrays: 28 or 23 antennas; no ACA or total power (Cycle 0)
data.sensitivity: SM1 2.0 mJy/beam; SM1N 0.3 mJy/beam; H2D+ 0.07 Jy/beam per 0.15 km/s

what.value: Hildebrand dust opacity kappa_0 = 0.1 cm2/g at 1000 GHz

evidence.quote: we normalize $\kappa_0 = 0.1$ cm$^2$ g$^{-1}$ at 1000 GHz (cite: hildebrand83)
where $d = 120$ pc is the distance to Oph A (cite: loinard08).

what.value: H2D+ Einstein A = 1.08e-4 s^-1, E_u/k = 17.8 K

evidence.quote: $E_u/k = 17.8$ K, and $A_{ul} = 1.08 \times 10^{-4}$ s$^{-1}$ for the ortho-H$_2$D$^+$  $1_{11} - 1_{10}$ transition (cite: raman04)

recipe.method: MFS imaging of all four spws; uniform weighting for SM1 after self-cal, natural multiscale for SM1N
Single 2D Gaussian fit with uvmodelfit to 359 GHz windows
Optically thin dust mass M = d^2 S/(kappa B(T_d))
key_parameters: kappa_0 = 0.1 cm2/g at 1000 GHz; beta 1.8 (SM1N), 0.4 (SM1) from SMA/ALMA
assumptions: T_d = gas temperature; SM1N 16 K from NH3; SM1 >=30 K; d = 120 pc

recipe.goal: Fit H2D+ line and derive column density and abundance
recipe.method: 1D Gaussian per pixel above 3 sigma; opacity and column density with Tex = 12 K; N(H2) from tapered continuum at Td = 17 K
Herschel 70 um 3-sigma limits converted via Dunham et al. 2008 relation

evidence.quote: We find kinetic gas temperatures $T_K = 16.0 \pm 0.7$ K toward SM1N.
we find the SM1N condensation has a mass of 0.02 M$_\odot$
$v_{LSR} = 3.75$ km s$^{-1}$, and a mean line width (FWHM) $\Delta v = 0.46$ km s$^{-1}$
Typical uncertainties on these values are $\sim 0.06$ km s$^{-1}$  and $\sim 0.1$ km s$^{-1}$, respectively.
We find a maximum ortho-H$_2$D$^+$  column density $N(\mbox{ortho-H$_2$D$^+$}) = 1.2 \times 10^{13}$ cm$^{-2}$ at the integrated intensity H$_2$D$^+$  peak.
The maximum abundance thus derived is $X(\mbox{ortho-H$_2$D$^+$}) = 10^{-10}$

not_stated_but_needed: Self-calibration solint and number of iterations for SM1
Cell size, image size, clean masks and thresholds
Taper parameters for the H2D+ cube
Line-free channels used for continuum subtraction
Phase centre / reference positions used for uv-averaging bins
ATCA NH3 data and SMA data are unpublished (in preparation)
missing_for_reproduction: Unpublished ATCA NH3 and SMA data
score_reason: Data are identifiable and the analysis is mostly simple, but imaging parameters and auxiliary data are missing.
rediscovery_reason: A single Cycle 0 project; the uvmodelfit and mass recipe is simple and the results are numeric.
